note: Levels shape: every level is its own place and gets a LEVEL n stamp plus a counting dB stamp, louder each time; level 5 (Krakatoa) is a prop-only island set; the payoff pays off the hook (3,000 miles, a police chief).

lines.see: On a Halden City street a five-bar LEVELS chart shoots up beside Kai as a LOUD! stamp slams in, then 3,000 MILES AWAY pops up by his head.
In the sunny park Wren whispers into Kai's ear, tiny sound rings pass between them, a LEVEL 1 · 30 dB stamp, Kai giggles.
In the classroom Kai and Bram talk under a 60 dB stamp, then a bar chart shows 70 dB ten times taller than 60 dB and 10x POWER slams in.
Back on the Halden street cars roar past, sound rings hit Kai, an 85 dB stamp, and a callout rings his sore ear.
In Halden plaza a crowd fist-pumps at a ROCK! concert, a 120 dB stamp slams in, and Kai is blasted back by PAIN!
A lone volcano island at sea under a 1883 stamp; the volcano explodes in a white flash, a smoke cloud and a pow star.
Closer on the erupting volcano, huge sound rings roll out over the sea while a 170 dB stamp counts up, then 100 MILES.
On a quiet street the police chief beside his car jumps as rings arrive, 3,000 MILES, and he says CANNONS?! in a speech bubble.
